annotations.title: Show the analytics for a watch

description: Shows analytics for a watch: where listed prices sit, prices by year and by what is included, new listings each day, price history when there is enough, a price checker and background on the model. Use it for questions about value, trends or how a price compares. Based on listed prices from dealer posts of the last 14 days, not sold prices.

brand.description: Brand name, such as Rolex or Patek Philippe.

query.description: What the customer asked for, in their words. Understands nicknames ("batgirl"), models ("daytona"), references ("126710BLNR"), years ("2016 or 2020") and budgets ("under 20k"), and budgets and dial colours in Spanish, French, German, Italian and Portuguese ("menos de 15 mil", "cadran bleu").

reference.description: An exact reference number, such as 126710BLNR or 5711/1A. The most exact search: pass it whenever the customer's words settle on one reference: a number they gave, or one they picked from the references an answer offered. Nicknames go in query, which knows them.
